title: Sega Ages: Columns Arcade Collection
native_title: セガエイジス コラムス・アーケード・コレクション
overview:
Sega Ages: Columns Arcade Collection is a compilation of four arcade Columns games, and was released exclusively in Japan for the Sega Saturn as part of the Sega Ages series.

• Columns
• Columns II: The Voyage Through Time
• Stack Columns
• Columns '97
